hooks.command: if [ -f package.json ]; then npm run lint --if-present; fi

t=$(jq -r '.agent_type // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ "$t" = "worker-implementer" ] && { mkdir -p docs/swarm; echo "[$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)] Worker finished. Checker required before completion." >> docs/swarm/verification-log.md; }; exit 0
